attchmntText: Munjal Auto Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on November 13, 2026.
voiceSummary: Munjal Auto Industries Limited approved unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, during its 209th Board Meeting held on November 13, 2026. The Board meeting commenced at 12.00 Noon and concluded at 3.40 p.m. Revenue from operations for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, stood at 49,035.67 lakhs on a standalone basis and 80,927.71 lakhs on a consolidated basis. Profit after tax for the quarter was 452.51 lakhs standalone and 907.26 lakhs consolidated. Earnings per share were 0.45 rupees basic and diluted for the standalone quarter. The results include a mark-to-market loss of 491.99 lakhs on investments. The financial results have been reviewed by Statutory Auditors.

attchmntText: Munjal Auto Industries Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Munjal Auto Industries Limited approved unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, during its 209th Board Meeting on November 13, 2026. The Board reviewed the results, which include a limited review report by Statutory Auditors. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, revenue from operations was Rs. 80,927.71 lakhs, with a profit after tax of Rs. 907.26 lakhs. Earnings per equity share stood at Rs. 0.76. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, revenue from operations was Rs. 1,50,829.19 lakhs, and profit after tax was Rs. 3,757.68 lakhs. Earnings per equity share for the half year were Rs. 3.34. The meeting commenced at 12.00 Noon and concluded at 3.40 p.m. on the same day.
